extraction_method: Pinned native source JSONL, grouped by message ID; exactly one complete text block per message; never join, trim, normalize, redact or rewrite.
manual_review: All selected full messages inspected for original task narrative, privacy and third-party quotation/code exclusions. Contributor certification is the rights basis, not independent proof of ownership.
selection_policy: Complete 160–12000-character messages; selection spread over sessions and heuristic task stages; reviewed subset from private filtered candidates. Not selected for lint cleanliness.
